name: vulcan
description: Agent-first CLI for trading perpetual futures on Phoenix DEX (Solana).

interface.shortDescription: Trade Solana perpetuals on Phoenix DEX from your AI agent.
interface.longDescription: Agent-first CLI with a built-in MCP server. Covers spot market data, paper trading, portfolio intel, perpetuals execution (market + limit, TP/SL, isolated margin), and first-class strategy runners (TWAP, grid, rule-based TA strategies). Ships with 16 goal-oriented skills for onboarding, market intel, technical analysis, and risk-aware execution. Paper trading and read-only data work with no setup; live trading requires the user to set `VULCAN_WALLET_NAME` + `VULCAN_WALLET_PASSWORD` and add `--allow-dangerous` to the server args.
defaultPrompt: Give me a morning portfolio brief: positions, open orders, margin health, and funding exposure.
Paper-trade an RSI mean-reversion strategy on SOL 5m for 30 minutes and show me the fills.
Scan SOL, BTC, and ETH perpetuals for funding-rate carry opportunities and rank them.
